scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: An impressive image
scenes.caption: Vihaan receives a fictional payment image in the Decision Lab. It claims ₹750 under reference B22 and displays a success banner. Aditi records the claim; the picture gives no access to the recipient’s provider history.
scenes.speech: Vihaan receives a fictional payment image in the Decision Lab. It claims ₹750 under reference B22 and displays a success banner. Aditi records the claim; the picture gives no access to the recipient’s provider history.
scenes.dialogue: An image states a claim about a payment.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A separate ledger
scenes.caption: The supplied provider ledger lists B22 as pending, not completed. Their teacher directs them to the known provider record. The class uses paper records only and makes no prediction about when that pending status will change.
scenes.speech: The supplied provider ledger lists B22 as pending, not completed. Their teacher directs them to the known provider record. The class uses paper records only and makes no prediction about when that pending status will change.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Match the reference
scenes.caption: Aditi aligns the image and ledger using the same reference and amount. Matching identifies the row; pending remains unconfirmed. Vihaan keeps the sender’s success claim beside the conflicting status instead of deleting the disagreement.
scenes.speech: Aditi aligns the image and ledger using the same reference and amount. Matching identifies the row; pending remains unconfirmed. Vihaan keeps the sender’s success claim beside the conflicting status instead of deleting the disagreement.
scenes.dialogue: Matching fields do not override status.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: What is confirmed?
scenes.caption: The learner chooses to check the recipient-side record with the teacher before releasing a fictional reservation. A request for clarification is useful even without proof of deliberate deception. Neither accusations nor another transfer resolve this evidence gap.
scenes.speech: The learner chooses to check the recipient-side record with the teacher before releasing a fictional reservation. A request for clarification is useful even without proof of deliberate deception. Neither accusations nor another transfer resolve this evidence gap.
scenes.dialogue: Check first; do not invent intent.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Credits and reversals
scenes.caption: Other supplied rows show B21 completed at ₹480 and B24 completed at ₹220. B23 records a ₹320 credit followed by an equal ₹320 reversal. Aditi pairs reversal and reference, excluding that credit from retained money.
scenes.speech: Other supplied rows show B21 completed at ₹480 and B24 completed at ₹220. B23 records a ₹320 credit followed by an equal ₹320 reversal. Aditi pairs reversal and reference, excluding that credit from retained money.
scenes.dialogue: Retained credit requires the whole stated trail.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A supported total
scenes.caption: Vihaan totals the retained completed credits and records ₹700. The pending image claim contributes nothing to that confirmed total. Their reconciliation table preserves reference, status and arithmetic separately, ready for revision if a later supplied provider record changes the evidence.
